license.weights: LTX-2 Community License Agreement (LTX-2.3 derivative; the HF repo has no model card); Gemma 3: Gemma Terms of Use

notes: Portrait + supplied speech (audio_in) -> 640x640 25 fps video in 32-frame AR chunks (upstream sampler, 4 steps, 1 history chunk + first-chunk sink, one GPU). Visual controls go into the text prompt of the next AR chunk (control map avatarforever-control-map/1); camera / scene / appearance-only controls are acked unsupported. Each chunk is conditioned on audio up to 0.28 s past its last frame (upstream's audio-to-chunk alignment), so it starts only after that audio has arrived. audio_out = the received speech, frame-aligned.
